title: A Mark on the Door Every Hour
subtitle: 损害评估 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 损害评估（灾害防范·损害与评估）
meta: 主题语境：损害评估（灾害防范·损害与评估）　|　核心词汇：trouble　|　正文 308 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 trouble 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: The ① trouble began at six in the morning and was over by eleven, and it left eleven houses with water in them and one without. The ② trouble, as the man from the council explained, was not the water but the mud, because mud is a thing you have to carry out and water is a thing that goes away.

In 1968 the pump at the top of the street had ③ trouble and nobody had repaired it, and the trouble was reported eleven times, and in 1974 everybody said that was why the water had come so far and so fast.

Eleven households were ④ in trouble with the insurance, because the forms asked whether the water had risen or fallen and nobody could say. My father did not ⑤ trouble the man from the council with the question, because he said a man with a clipboard has already decided. What ⑥ troubled him, and what he never said out loud, was that he had known about the pump in 1968 and had said nothing.

The woman at number eleven ⑦ took the trouble to measure it, which nobody else did: she put a mark on the door every hour for eleven hours, and her marks are the reason we know how high it got and how fast. Without her the assessors would have ⑧ had trouble deciding anything at all, and they said so, and they put her name in the report, and nobody read the report.

The ⑨ trouble, meaning the money, took eleven years: the last cheque came in 1985 and was for eleven pounds, and my father pinned it to the wall, and there was no trouble after 1985. The ⑩ trouble I have with the story is that he had known about the pump, and I have never asked him about it, and he died in 1998, and now I cannot.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 麻烦；困难；问题
B. n. 麻烦事；惹出的乱子；症结所在
C. n. 故障；毛病；（机器的）问题
D. v. 麻烦（别人）；打扰
E. v. 使烦恼；使忧虑；使不安
F. 固定搭配：be in trouble（with ...）处于困境／麻烦中
G. 固定搭配：take the trouble to do ... 特意／不辞辛劳做……
H. 固定搭配：have trouble (in) doing ... 做……有困难

items.q: The trouble began at six in the morning
the trouble, as the man from the council explained
the pump at the top of the street had trouble
Eleven households were in trouble with the insurance
My father did not trouble the man from the council
What troubled him, and what he never said
took the trouble to measure it
would have had trouble deciding anything
The trouble, meaning the money, took eleven years
The trouble I have with the story

answers.why: the trouble 意为“麻烦、事故”，这场麻烦早上六点开始，十一点前就结束了。
the trouble 意为“症结所在、真正的麻烦”，议会的人说，症结不在水而在淤泥。
have trouble 意为“（机器）出故障、有毛病”，1968 年街口那台水泵就出了故障，没人修。
be in trouble with ... 意为“与……之间陷入麻烦、有纠纷”，十一户人家与保险公司之间陷入了麻烦。
trouble 作动词，意为“麻烦（别人）、打扰”，父亲没有拿这个问题去麻烦议会那个人。
troubled 意为“使烦恼、使不安”，真正让他不安的是他 1968 年就知道水泵的事却什么也没说。
take the trouble to do ... 意为“特意／不辞辛劳地做……”，十一号那位女士特意去测量了水位，别人都没做。
have trouble (in) doing ... 意为“做……有困难”，没有她，评估员根本无法作出任何判断。
the trouble 意为“麻烦、问题”，钱的问题拖了十一年。
the trouble 意为“问题、困扰”，我对这个故事始终耿耿于怀的一点是：他早就知道水泵的事。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 这场麻烦早上六点开始，十一点前就结束了，十一户人家进了水。（trouble）
议会的人说，症结不在水而在淤泥。（trouble）

十一号那位女士特意去测量了水位，每小时在门上画一道。（take the trouble to）
没有她，评估员根本无法作出任何判断。（have trouble doing）

As the man from the council explained, the trouble was not the water but the mud.
In 1968 the pump at the top of the street had trouble, and it was reported eleven times.
Eleven households were in trouble with the insurance, because the forms asked whether the water had risen or fallen.
The woman at number eleven took the trouble to measure it, putting a mark on the door every hour.
Without her the assessors would have had trouble deciding anything at all.
